questions.question: Isaiah warned that Sheol would open its enormous jaws. Whose nobles and masses go down into it?

answers.text: They lost a long war with Egypt
They let their fields go unplanted

questions.question: How did the LORD call distant nations at the ends of the earth to come against His people?

answers.text: He sent a dream to their kings
